name: use-event-listener
title: useEventListener
description: Custom hook that attaches event listeners to DOM elements, the window, or media query lists.

tags.template: - The type of the DOM element (default is `HTMLElement`).

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: - The name of the event to listen for.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.type:
(
    event:
      | WindowEventMap[KW]
      | HTMLElementEventMap[KH]
      | SVGElementEventMap[KH]
      | MediaQueryListEventMap[KM]
      | Event,
  ) => void

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: - The DOM element or media query list to attach the event listener to (optional).

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: - An options object that specifies characteristics about the event listener (optional).
